description: This file defines the ProfilerExtension class in Twig, which manages profiling during template rendering. It handles entering and leaving profiling profiles and provides a node visitor for profiling purposes.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\ProfilerExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension that adds profiling capabilities by managing active profiles and attaching node visitors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the extension with a given Profile object and adds it to the active profiles stack.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Starts profiling for a given profile by adding it to the active profiles and calling addProfile.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Ends profiling for a profile, managing the active profiles stack accordingly.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array of node visitors used for profiling during template compilation.
